_capture.selection: 200 événements : les plus récents par revision + 8 sources des propositions échantillonnées ; text remplacé par sa longueur ; id/supersedes/session_id/proposal_id/source_ids hachés (sel commun, format conservé, références croisées cohérentes)

schema.events: CREATE TABLE events(id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,surface TEXT,kind TEXT,text TEXT,created_at TEXT,ingested_at TEXT, supersedes TEXT, revision INTEGER, session_id TEXT)
schema.memory_meta: CREATE TABLE memory_meta(key TEXT PRIMARY KEY,value TEXT NOT NULL)
schema.session_cursors:
CREATE TABLE session_cursors(
            session_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,surface TEXT NOT NULL,last_seen_revision INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
            updated_at TEXT NOT NULL)
schema.dream_proposals:
CREATE TABLE dream_proposals(
            proposal_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,run_id TEXT NOT NULL,action TEXT NOT NULL,
            source_ids TEXT NOT NULL,payload TEXT NOT NULL,status TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'proposed',
            created_at TEXT NOT NULL,applied_at TEXT)
schema.idx_events_revision: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX idx_events_revision ON events(revision)
schema.events_fts: CREATE VIRTUAL TABLE events_fts USING fts5(text,content='events',content_rowid='rowid',tokenize='unicode61 remove_diacritics 2')
schema.events_search_insert: CREATE TRIGGER events_search_insert AFTER INSERT ON events BEGIN INSERT INTO events_fts(rowid,text) VALUES(new.rowid,new.text); END
schema.events_search_delete: CREATE TRIGGER events_search_delete AFTER DELETE ON events BEGIN INSERT INTO events_fts(events_fts,rowid,text) VALUES('delete',old.rowid,old.text); END
schema.events_search_update: CREATE TRIGGER events_search_update AFTER UPDATE OF text ON events BEGIN INSERT INTO events_fts(events_fts,rowid,text) VALUES('delete',old.rowid,old.text); INSERT INTO events_fts(rowid,text) VALUES(new.rowid,new.text); END
schema.curator_fingerprints: CREATE TABLE curator_fingerprints(event_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,kind TEXT NOT NULL,norm_hash TEXT NOT NULL)

view_projection_v1.token_estimate_basis: UTF-8 bytes / 3; estimate only; hard bound is bytes
